Terms and Conditions Introduction The indent is for Igniter & LOx Heating Module (ILHM) component for Hybrid Motor. The scope of the w ork is precision fabrication wherein party has to fabricate the components as per the drawings. 1.0 Scope of Work 1.1 The scope of work involves rough machining, precision/CNC turning, milling, drilling, tapping, fittin g, trial assembly of components, final assembly checks, 100% components inspection and documentati on as per the drawings and specifications out of materials supplied by VSSC. 1.2 The list of items to be fabricated, their drawings nos. and quantity of Igniter for Hybrid Motor are p rovided in Annexure -1. 2.0 Materials 2.1 The raw materials required for the manufacture of the components is to be supplied by VSSC as FI M. 2.2 Party have to submit Bank guarantee of Rs. 200,000/- towards the value of FIM. 2.3 Component identification has to be engraved only at location specified in the drawing for metallic h ardware. For Silica Phenolic & graphite, identification no. has to be provided by Tag/ permanent marke r a specified in the drawings. 2.4 The details of FIM are given in Annexure I are approximate sizes. The actual supplied size may have variation based on available material at VSSC stores. 3.0 Manufacture, Assembly and Supply conditions 3.1 All drawing parameters have to be measured and inspected directly using suitable instruments as per approved QC plan and separate readings with maximum/minimum are to be provided in inspection report. Also, typical features (parameters) are to be separately measured and reported against each lo cation. 3.2 Standard design considerations are to be adopted for fixing the parameters such as design toleran ce, cylindricity etc. of the hardware components. Typical values are specified in the drawings which ma y be suitably modified and drawing is to be supplied to us for final approval before start of work.

3.3 Party has to carry out trial assembly of the full system as per the assembly drawing. 3.4 Trial suiting of mating components viz, nozzle end, integrated sleeve, throat, face insulation and co nvergent insulation shall be ensured as per sub assembly drawing no. 336 215 17 013000 D2 (will be pr ovided after PO placement). 3.5 Hardware has to be delivered only after completing all the above activities and after obtaining spe cific dispatch clearance from VSSC. 3.6 Minor changes in the design, drawings & processes etc. if any, during the course of execution of th e order may be undertaken without any additional cost. 4.0 Storage Protection 4.1 Components are to be properly stored in Polyethylene bags containing silica gel to prevent corrosio n from atmospheric moisture. 5.0 Essential Facilities Required 5.1 The party shall have the required facilities to meet the specified manufacturing tolerances on geom etry and size of components/assemblies. 5.2 The party shall have an independent inspection facility and man-power to carry out Quality Control activities. 5.3 It is preferable that the party does not sub contract any portion of the work. However, in exception al cases, the party may do so with the prior formal approval of VSSC, in such cases the party shall ensu re and shall be fully responsible for the quality of the item made by the sub-contractor. 6.0 Engineering Documents 6.1 On receipt of the order, the party shall submit Process & QC Plan within one month, incorporating o perations details, online & mandatory QC stages, machine tools, tooling details, instruments employed. The Plan shall cover all stages of operations from raw material to finished product. This shall be submi tted to VSSC for review and approval. 6.2 The production shall commence only after the approval of Process and Quality Control Plan by VSSC . 6.3 Four sets of approved Process and QC plans shall be given to VSSC for reference and one copy shall be retained by the party. Any change from the approved plan, if required, shall be effected only with th e concurrence of VSSC. 7.0 Toolings 7.1 Tools, instruments and thread gauges wherever required shall be essentially procured by the party. 7.2 All gauges, templates, jigs and fixtures, press tools etc. used for manufacturing and inspection shal l be identified and qualified as per requirements. All measuring instruments shall be in good condition and periodically calibrated by approved agencies accredited to NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing & Calibrating Laboratories). 7.3 The party shall maintain a Master List of measuring instruments and gauges containing the relevan t details like identification number, range, resolution, and calibration status. 7.4 Party shall ensure that the machines used for critical operations are periodically maintained for sp ecific accuracies. 8.0 Inspection

8.1 Party shall be responsible for online inspection, stage clearance and final inspection of all products as per drawing and specification. The party shall perform 100% inspection and report actual values for all the dimensions/specifications including visual observations. 8.2 In the case of threaded components, in addition to gauging by GO & NOGO thread gauges, major di ameter of external threads and minor diameter of internal threads shall also be measured and reporte d. All the thread parameters shall conform to IS: 4218. 8.3 Dye Penetrate test shall be carried out on components as specified in the process plan. 8.4 Processing shall be systematized and all technical observations during the processing of job shall b e recorded in a shop log book meant for VSSC jobs. Specific observations about the process and inspec tion methods shall be recorded in the above log book. 8.5 Inspection report shall be prepared in the specified format (A4 size) in computer print out with font size not less than 10 and submitted to VSSC. 8.6 Non-conformance, if any, shall be highlighted through a separate snag sheet and submitted along w ith the inspection report. 8.7 All drawing parameters have to be measured and inspected directly using suitable instruments as per approved QC plan and separate readings are to be provided in inspection report. Also, typical featu res (parameters) are to be separately measured and reported against each location. 9.0 Acceptance 9.1 VSSC Quality personnel, referred as Surveyor, shall carry out online/offline mode quality surveillanc e and key point inspections at the mandatory stages identified in the process plan after receipt and scr utiny of the reports. Surveyor shall have unhindered access to all relevant shops and departments. 9.2 Four copies of the Surveyor certified inspection reports shall be given to VSSC. 9.3 A checklist consisting of identification of components in each set, inspection report reference of all operations, waiver detail (if any) shall be submitted prior to despatch. 10.0 Guarantee & Replacement The party shall guarantee that the hardware supplied shall comply fully with the specifications laid do wn for material, workmanship and performance for a period of twelve months after the acceptance of t he hardware, if any defects are discovered therein or any defects found to have developed under prop er use, arising from faulty hardware or workmanship, the party shall remedy such defects at his own c ost provided he is called upon to do so within a period of 60 days from the date of acceptance. 11.0 Delivery Schedule 11.1 First set (Each Component) is to be delivered within 60 days from date of placement of PO. The re maining items should be delivered after 90 days after clearance from VSSC. 11.2 The party shall plan the manufacturing activities pertaining to this order as well as orders for oth er items from VSSC, if any, simultaneously and adhere to the respective delivery schedule. 12.0 Packing and Forwarding 12.1 Inspected and accepted items shall be dispatched only after obtaining specific dispatch clearance from VSSC. 12.2 Party shall properly pack each item as per instruction with proper support to prevent transit dama ges and supply to VSSC on door delivery basis. 13.0 General

13.1 The party shall quote the individual cost for each component listed in Annexure-1. A detailed cost breakdown, categorized by component and process, shall be indicated separately. Quotes must be pro vided on a per-component basis rather than as a total price per set 13.2 Important: The party shall quote for the full scope of work. The offers with partial scope of work c annot be considered and liable for rejection. 13.3 VSSC reserves the right to place the order either in full or part for which no change of price is per mitted. 13.4 VSSC also reserves the right to short close the order in the event of failure to deliver the compone nts as per the specification and within the stipulated delivery schedule, without any compensation wha tsoever, and retrieve all the materials at party’s cost. You shall quote as per the technical specification mentioned in ATC Document. Your bid will be evaluat ed based on our required specification attached in ATC document. Bidder should mandatorily submit A TC compliance statement along with the Bid. Bids without ATC compliance statement will be summarily rejected. For all bid clarification queries related to this bid.
